Particle

This page contains the class named Particle. Each Particle object stores information related to a search instance.

Initialization

class Particle.Particle(tag, index, initial_score, weight=0, duration=0)[source]

A class to store information about a data point. Acts as a particle in the filter.

tag

The name of the file

Type:

str

index

The index value

Type:

int

current

The determined value by this particle

Type:

dict

score

The calculated score value

Type:

int

Initialize a Particle object.

Parameters:

  • tag (string) – The name of the file. This is used to find the corresponding data to search from.

  • index (int) – The index value to search the file.

  • initial_score (float) – The initial score of a particle. Do not use zero, recommend (1/number of particles) to prevent selection errors.

  • weight (float, optional) – The current selection probability for this particle. The default is 0 for new particles. Assigned at runtime.

Return type:

None.

calculate_score(true_value, method='rmspe')[source]

Assigns a score to the particle relative to a measured or true value (true_value). Output is for testing only and not used by the particle filter.

Parameters:

  • true_value (dict) – The sensor value to compare the particle value to.

  • method (string, optional) – Determines the type of method to use to calculate score.. The default is “rmspe”.

Returns:

The calculated score value based on the selected error function and provided measured or true value.

Return type:

float (optional)

forward(max_idx)[source]

Moves the particle foward in the same dataset and increment life

Parameters:

max_idx (int) – Maximum index of the reference datafile. If a CSV has 200 rows, then max_idx=200. Assigned automatically by code.

Return type:

None.
